profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: 20+ Years Experience in Software Development with a focus on automation. Interested in a variety of areas including CI/CD, test automation frameworks, and test case development.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
Accelerated release process by automating existing manual test cases requiring 1 man-week to execute down to 2 hours

Developed Golang based Kubernetes controller to reduce the DNS traffic between sidecar proxies and the Kubernetes DNS server in our customer environments by as much as 99%

Programmed support for Kubernetes controller to execute independently to allow for blue/green deployments

Investigated issues related to garbage collection and resulting out-of-memory terminations, ensuring we could lower memory limits by 50% without outages

Ensured our Kubernetes controller minimized DNS TTL expiration concerns in failover situations by improving failover times by 90%

Participated in on-call rotation, helped with triaging escalations, and developed tests to reproduce discovered issues

Engineered scale-from-zero configuration within our build Kubernetes cluster to replace a static set of nodes resulting in >75% cost reduction

Eliminated Kubernetes cluster maintenance and 95% of the cloud expenditure of our self-hosted documentation by designing and implementing a CloudFront w/ Lambda@Edge implementation as a replacement using CloudFormation to ensure it leveraged infrastructure-as-code
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Configuration Management · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Cloud Infrastructure · CircleCI · Kubernetes · Bash · Istio · Go (Programming Language) · Helm (Software)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
Coordinated and automated test plans using Python for new feature development as part of an agile team working on a distributed, scale-out storage system

Guided transformation to containerized architectures for test execution environments, ensuring rapid, consistent, and reliable test execution environments

Served as member of code owner group responsible for mentoring and performing code reviews on both new test assertion and framework contributions

positions.title: Software Quality Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented Python-based scalable, distributed test framework responsible for functional/system testing of Hyper-Converged Product

Guided test case plans and implemented test strategies as Test Architect for data path of Midrange storage product

Represented System Test team in charge of Installation and Upgrade areas for VNX and VNXe product lines

Built CI/CD pipelines for multiple repositories that made up the test framework, resulting in a versioned docker image containing test framework and tests

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to Automated Results and Triage Service team, a system that integrates into the test framework which automated defect filing, triaged support materials, routed defects to appropriate teams, and identified possible duplicate defects

Integrated Puppet Enterprise into our Continuous Test Environment to ensure the 200+ servers had up-to-date software in a 24/7 test environment without impacting production tests

Enabled system test upgrade process by implementing efficient upgrade and downgrade tools
